waitingRoom.description: Virtual waiting room before high-demand match sales. When off, 'Join the waiting room' becomes 'Get tickets'.

exactSeatSelection.description: Lets fans pick exact stadium seats by block instead of only choosing a zone.

cinema.description: Cinema showtimes and seat booking, including the Cinema navigation link.

resale.description: Official face-value resale: Resale navigation, Resell buttons and the /resale page.

ticketTransfer.description: Transferring tickets to another Fan ID, phone number or email.

fanId.description: Fan ID onboarding (/fan-id) and the related calls to action.

promoCodes.description: Promo codes at checkout and presale codes on event pages.

notifyMe.description: 'Notify me' and 'Set reminder' buttons for upcoming sales.

parkingUpsell.description: Parking add-on offer on the match order confirmation page.

notificationCentre.description: Notification bell in the header and the /notifications page (orders, transfers, refunds, event changes).

addToWallet.description: Apple/Google wallet passes. Disabled until the pass service is live.

arabicLanguage.description: Arabic (RTL) language toggle in the header. Disabled until translations ship.
